Popular RAMpocalypse support GTA 6 Halloween Modern Warfare 4 Clips Quizzes Games Action Grand Theft Auto Grand Theft Auto 6 Edge magazine went to Rockstar to see GTA 6, and will tell you all about it in lavish detail this Thursday, October 29 News By Joshua Wolens Published 27 October 2026 I bet you can steal cars. When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here's how it works . Copy link Facebook X Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter We are just three weeks out from the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 , which you can tell because it has cleared the release calendar around it like the Chicxulub crater. Ahead of the big day, our friends at Edge magazine visited Rockstar's Edinburgh development HQ to chat with the studio's leaders and put their eyes on GTA 6 in action . That's right folks, it's officially happening. This thing is officially almost a videogame you can play. The result? The 16-page cover story coming in Edge #430, on sale October 29 . They've really been cooking over there, bringing us a bunch of exclusive new imagery, interviews with Rockstar head honchos, and a special gatefold cover with artwork of Jason and Lucia, about whom I already have very strong feelings. If you're in the UK, you're in luck, because you can pick up the GTA 6 special edition free, plus 13 issues of Edge at 38% off the price you'd pay at the newsstand if you subscribe at this link . Outside the UK? Don't fret, because new subs will get a free digital edition of the GTA 6 special issue if you subscribe here . And wherever you are, the full 16-page feature will drop here for everyone to read for free on October 29, coinciding with the release of the magazine. You may like GTA 6 cars need gas? OK, I'm finally on board GTA 6: What we know about Rockstar's return to Vice City GTA 6 won't be letting up on the satire: 'If you are going to put all this effort into creating a version of today's world, it has to be more over the top, more insane, more in your face' Image 1 of 2 (Image credit: Future) (Image credit: Future) Image 1 of 2 View Original Image 2 of 2 View Original It's lavish, lovely, and in-depth-so all very Edge, and if you're one of the approximately 8 billion people who are desperate to know more about the most-anticipated game in Rockstar's history (or, well, just history in general, probably), you're gonna want to feast your eyes on it.
